steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: You... I've seen you somewhere before... comrade. We've met on the battlefield before.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: ...Hey, hey. You shouldn't have come to Chernobog. Everybody here has the intel on Rhodes Island. You're all going to die here.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: But no matter how good you are, you shouldn't have been able to get through W's defensive line. Not unless...

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: By the looks of things, she ended up making that choice after all. In fact, we all expected it.

options: Some of you fought with us, side-by-side.
That's the only reason we're still exchanging words on the battlefield.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: ...Theresa was an exceptional leader. She changed the way many people see this patch of dirt.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: But it was an idealized viewpoint.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: You don't need to argue with me. I know better than you the cruelty that Kazdel has faced, nor do I want to deny her. But for such a tremendous effort, I just want to see some semblance of results.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: Only by the Regent's hand can a new future come to Kazdel. There's not enough goodwill to go around for everyone.

options: We could have tried to work together. Or at least so that we don't have to die together.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: A naive notion. How are we supposed to set aside our years of discontent as Sarkaz? How are we to right a long history of wrongs?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: Ursus and the uninfected. Reunion and the Infected. Kazdel and the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: It's all the same. I became more convinced of it during the time I spent working with Reunion.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: His Royal Highness, the Regent, can open a new home for us, and I've chosen to chase this opportunity.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: Just as in the past, you still naively cling to Theresa.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: ...That's enough.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: Since W decided to let you through, you must've also paid the price.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: What did you give up? An underling who died to buy you time? Or... maybe your own soul?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: Tell me the name you go by now.

options: Don't mercenaries also use codenames, Garcin?

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: It's been a while since I heard that name. Originally, I wanted to carve your name onto this knife as a show of respect.

steps.name: Sarkaz Mercenary Leader
steps.text: ...But you're right.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Stop resisting.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...The twelve other members of your team have been eliminated.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Leafa, Mimi, and Thumbtack died after being surrounded by Reunion casters. One died on her feet.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Mary, Macron, Slink, and Scorpion held a section that W broke with her own team.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Milim, Tipsy, and Mudflower took one of our teams down with them. One of them fought her way out of the trap, but Hoederer's swordsmen got her head.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Unexpectedly, Pter died downstairs over there not too long ago. Apparently tried to save some civilian who didn't have time to evacuate.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Slanna's still breathing and we took her in, but she's probably looking for some way to kill herself.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ....What, nothing to say?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Stop hiding. I know you can hear me. I can see your shadow, and I can tell from your ragged breathing that you're badly wounded.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: ...Why do you know their names?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: W told me specifically for the occasion. You guys keep some kind of dogtags on you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: 'At least you have to know who you killed. This isn't Kazdel anymore. It'd be bad if you killed the wrong person.'

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Those aren't dogtags, and the operators we lost... weren't all soldiers.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I thought W would finish me herself.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hmph. She... Would you believe me if I told you that she doesn't have the heart to do that?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You killed the leader that the Regent sent. She's not the only one who wants to take over, so she has her hands full.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Like the agreement you had with W.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: As soon as you complete your mission, we'll annihilate you with all our strength, in 'hindsight.'

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...During the firefight, you even took the time to rescue someone. But, that's not any of our business.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Patriot is over there, so there's no need to bother with that.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: ...Good.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You've all... changed. W was not the kind of person to go out of her way to remember the names of the dead.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Yeah, she did change. But she's only become more of a lunatic.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Your experience on the battlefield is pure, like Faust's Arts. Who's to say that this wasn't just a ruse to trip you up? What if she only wrote down their names so I could toy with you with my Arts?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: ...That sounds like her. She would never miss an opportunity to have some fun.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Same with you. Didn't you also agree to this crazy deal that only W could come up with?

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Trading my life for an opportunity, then letting those who should take that opportunity follow through? There's nothing crazy about that.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Just like those who sacrificed their lives. They died for their own ideals. Without them, I cannot succeed.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...It seems like everyone's changed with the passing of time.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You too. You never would've given your enemy time to breathe, like you're doing now.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Hoederer should have warned you.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Why are you still resisting?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Tch... He's gone...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: But don't think you can get away so easily...

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (This way?)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (No doubt, this is the way. He's fast.)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (Tricky bastard. If he wasn't injured, I might not even be able to keep up...)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (Wait...)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (He... he's heading towards the middle of the city?)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: (That's where... Tch!)

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...Damn it!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: What are you after, so close to the core city?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Why can't you just get out of Chernobog?!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: ...You really don't act like a Sarkaz at times, Ines.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: I never was one.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: —You should keep pretending that you are. You are a Sarkaz mercenary, and this is the battlefield.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: You can't even run anymore. You've lost too much blood, your head is spinning, and your limbs are going numb. Your shadow's the only thing still burning. You shouldn't even be able to stand.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: I'm well aware of my own injuries. Besides, this place is crawling with Reunion.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: But for the lot of you... You, Hoederer, and also W... I have a suggestion.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ...For Her Majesty's sake.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Use those eyes of yours to see the truth, and don't die in vain before that.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: We Sarkaz... should not allow others to continue to use us.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Are you talking about my Arts? What am I supposed to be seeing—

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: ——What... this... Who is this... why...?

steps.name: Talulah?
steps.text: ...Sarkaz?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Impossible... She saw me?!

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: (Now's my chance—!)

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Long time no see.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Nngh... You? So... you're alive...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've been following you this whole time. I figured Ines alone wouldn't be enough to handle an elite like you.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: The price to pay for this information is your life. And though we never planned to show any mercy, I did hope that you would...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: But now, we can't give you any more chances. You're too close to the core city. W doesn't want anyone poking around over there.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: Heh... Sounds like... she's the captain now...

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You... always...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I'm sorry. Sleep now, old friend.

steps.name: Scout
steps.text: You... should not stay here...

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: ...I know, old friend.

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: I've known that all along.

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Hoederer!

steps.name: Hoederer
steps.text: You hesitated back there. Why?

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: —Hurry!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: We need to let W know, immediately!

steps.name: Ines
steps.text: Tch! She's coming!
